toggle_switch.title: LAN Bypass
toggle_switch.description: Allow network when PSN sign-in is blocked.

toggle_switch.title: Block Sony DNS
toggle_switch.description: Block telemetry and patch-check DNS calls.

toggle_switch.title: Region Free
toggle_switch.description: Remove region lock on discs and PKGs.

toggle_switch.title: Unlock Trophies
toggle_switch.description: Allow hidden/locked trophies to be earned.

toggle_switch.title: Skip Update Check
toggle_switch.description: Skip forced update checks on game launch.

toggle_switch.title: Max Fan Speed
toggle_switch.description: Force fans to 100%% at all times.

toggle_switch.description: Run fans at minimum speed (may overheat).

toggle_switch.title: Boost Mode
toggle_switch.description: Enable GPU boost clock (Pro: requires BC2 mode).

toggle_switch.title: BC2 7nm Mode
toggle_switch.description: PS4 Pro: enable 7nm power efficiency mode.

toggle_switch.title: Auto-resign Saves
toggle_switch.description: Auto-resign saves with active account ID on import.
